class.name: NNPerformanceMonitor
class.brief_description: Singleton that reports Noodle Nodes AI timings to Godot's custom performance monitors.
class.description: Engine singleton for profiling Noodle Nodes agents, behaviour trees, state trees, and HTN roots in Godot's Debugger > Monitors tab. Call [method initialize_performance_counters] once at startup and [method update_performance_counters] once per physics frame. Access it directly through [code]NNPerformanceMonitor[/code] without instantiating it.

method.name: get_total_time_elapsed_ai_agents_update_behaviour_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds [NNAgent] behaviour updates took during the last counted frame. This is the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/AI Agent update behaviour time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: get_total_time_elapsed_ai_agents_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds [NNAgent] option evaluation took during the last counted frame. This is the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/AI Agent evaluate options time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: get_total_time_elapsed_behaviour_trees_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds [NNBTRoot] ticks took during the last counted frame. This is the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/Behaviour Tree tick time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: get_total_time_elapsed_htn_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds [NNHTNRoot] ticks took during the last counted frame. This is the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/HTN tick time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: get_total_time_elapsed_state_trees_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds [NNSTRoot] ticks took during the last counted frame. This is the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/State Tree tick time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: increment_total_time_elapsed_ai_agents_update_behaviour_usec
method.description: Adds [param time_usec] to the agent behaviour update time of the current frame. Called by [NNAgent] in debug builds.

method.name: increment_total_time_elapsed_ai_agents_usec
method.description: Adds [param time_usec] to the agent option evaluation time of the current frame. Called by [NNAgent] in debug builds.

method.name: increment_total_time_elapsed_behaviour_trees_usec
method.description: Adds [param time_usec] to the behaviour tree tick time of the current frame. Called by [NNBTRoot] in debug builds.

method.name: increment_total_time_elapsed_htn_usec
method.description: Adds [param time_usec] to the HTN tick time of the current frame. Called by [NNHTNRoot] in debug builds.

method.name: increment_total_time_elapsed_state_trees_usec
method.description: Adds [param time_usec] to the state tree tick time of the current frame. Called by [NNSTRoot] in debug builds.

method.name: initialize_performance_counters
method.description: Adds the [code]NNPerformanceMonitor/*[/code] custom monitors to the [Performance] singleton and enables the monitor. Call it once at startup. Does nothing in release builds or when already initialized.

method.name: update_performance_counters
method.description: Publishes the times accumulated since the previous call to the monitors and starts counting a new frame. Call it once per physics frame.
